name: nuGeN
summary: nuGeN deploys a low-threshold high-purity germanium detector directly below a Kalinin reactor core to search for CEvNS. The movable installation exploits a high flux and changes source distance for systematic checks.
detection_principle: Germanium ionization signals are measured with low-noise electronics inside active and passive shielding. Reactor-on and reactor-off spectra are subtracted and fitted for a coherent-scattering contribution.

results.summary: No statistically significant difference between reactor-on and reactor-off rates was found; upper limits on CEvNS event numbers were derived.
